text_hash_convention: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 anchor text, excluding line terminator; DOCX anchor text concatenates descendant w:t nodes of the native paragraph.
docx_locator_convention: 1-based document-order w:p descendants of w:body, including empty paragraphs and paragraphs in tables

anchors.heading: The agent-completable unit
anchors.text: > **The largest coherent responsibility that one agent can understand, implement, verify locally, and hand back through a stable interface without needing to continually reason about unrelated parts of the system.**

anchors.query: Parallelize only across independent, separately gradable units
anchors.heading: Recommendations
anchors.text: **Parallelize only across independent, separately gradable units.** Keep one orchestrating loop that carries state. Use git-based task locks and one editor per shared interface. When work collapses into one monolithic failure, as with Carlini's kernel, use the oracle to split it before adding agents.
Measure usable connected capabilities (what a user can now do) rather than agent activity, test counts, or LOC.
